title: PUMA Philippine Half Marathon Series 2026 Clark Review: What the Clark Leg Was Like
seo_title: PUMA Half Marathon Series 2026 Clark Review | Filinvest Mimosa
meta_description: PUMA Philippine Half Marathon Series 2026 Clark review: a fast 21K at Filinvest Mimosa on 23 August, won in 1:09:23 and 1:21:00, with 10K and 5K races.
dek: The Clark leg of RunRio's PUMA Philippine Half Series was run at Filinvest Mimosa in the Clark Freeport Zone on 23 August 2026. Here is what it was like, from the report on it.
verdict: The Clark leg of the PUMA Philippine Half Series is a fast, well-supported half marathon with real quality at the front. The 2026 race, on Sunday 23 August at Filinvest Mimosa in the Clark Freeport Zone, was won by Gilbert Muge in 1:09:23 and Edna Magtubo in 1:21:00 [1]. There were also 10 km and 5 km races [1], and the organisers lined up hydration, electrolyte and tourism partners [1]. If you want a competitive half marathon in Central Luzon, with a series to build a season around, this is a good one.

sections.heading: The 2026 Clark Leg
paragraphs: The race was run on Sunday 23 August 2026 at Filinvest Mimosa in the Clark Freeport Zone, with PUMA as title sponsor and the Department of Tourism Region 3 as partner [1]. The Philstar report calls it the fourth race of the PUMA Philippine Half Series [1], which moved on to Cagayan de Oro on 6 September and finished with a Manila leg at the SM Mall of Asia on 11 October [1].
Water and electrolyte partners were named for the race, alongside a long list of sponsors [1].

sections.heading: A Fast Front of the Field
paragraphs: Gilbert Muge won the men's 21 km in 1:09:23, ahead of Edwin Kiptoo (1:11:55) and James Kevin Cruz (1:12:02) [1]. Edna Magtubo won the women's in 1:21:00, ahead of Pamela Chepkoech Bundotich (1:24:13) and Arlyn Joyce Akangan (1:28:08) [1].
Alfrence Braza won the men's 10 km in 33:24 and Jessa Mae Roda the women's in 46:48, and Fritz Angelo Operio and Kaye Kayralyn Villanueva won the 5 km [1].

sections.heading: Should You Enter Next Year?
paragraphs: If you want a half marathon in Central Luzon with a competitive field, yes. Winning times of 1:09 and 1:21 show a course that can be run fast.
The report says nothing about field size, water stations or conditions, so check those details before you enter.
This review is compiled from a published race report on the 2026 edition. It is not a first-hand race report, and nobody from this site ran the race.

faqs.question: Who won the PUMA Clark Half Marathon in 2026?
faqs.answer: Gilbert Muge won the men's 21 km in 1:09:23, ahead of Edwin Kiptoo and James Kevin Cruz, and Edna Magtubo won the women's in 1:21:00, ahead of Pamela Chepkoech Bundotich and Arlyn Joyce Akangan. The race was run on 23 August 2026 at Filinvest Mimosa, Clark.

faqs.question: Where is the PUMA Philippine Half Marathon Clark leg held?
faqs.answer: At Filinvest Mimosa in the Clark Freeport Zone, Pampanga. In 2026 it was part of the PUMA Philippine Half Series, which continued to Cagayan de Oro in September and finished with a Manila leg at the SM Mall of Asia in October.

faqs.question: What distances does the PUMA Clark Half Marathon offer?
faqs.answer: Three in 2026: the 21 km half marathon, a 10 km and a 5 km. The half marathon is the headline race, and winning times of 1:09 for men and 1:21 for women show a field and a course that allow fast running.
